info.title: pefix
info.description: Diagnose and fix PE header portability for .NET assemblies.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
pefix is a single-binary CLI that diagnoses and (selectively) repairs .NET assembly portability and load-failure issues.
Run `pefix <verb> --help` for verb-specific options.
Exit codes:
0  Success or no gate triggered
1  Failure-on-gate triggered, refusal, or non-compatible result
2  Usage error
4  IO error

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Apply the safe PE header fix. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply to write.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write changes to disk. Without this flag, the command only reports what would change.

options.name: --no-backup
options.description: Skip .bak file creation. Only meaningful with --apply.

options.name: --force
options.description: Allow patching cautioned assemblies. Only meaningful with --apply.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Assembly file or directory to fix.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with code 1 when the result meets or exceeds the given severity.

commands.name: pinvoke
commands.description: List P/Invoke calls in a managed assembly or directory.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Assembly file or directory to inspect.

commands.name: publicize
commands.description: Publicize types/methods/fields in a managed assembly. Default dry-run; pass --apply to write.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the file. Without this flag the run is dry-run only.

commands.name: redir
commands.description: Rewrite AssemblyRef version fields. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply to write.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write changes to disk. Without this flag, the command only reports what would change.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Assembly file or directory to redirect.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Scans a directory of managed assemblies for portability and integrity issues.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with code 1 when the result meets or exceeds the given severity.

options.name: --fail-on-conflict
options.description: Exit with code 1 when version conflicts are detected.

commands.name: snstrip
commands.description: Strip strong-name signing. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply to write.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write changes to disk. Without this flag, the command only reports what would change.

options.name: --force
options.description: Strip even when InternalsVisibleTo uses a signed PublicKey.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Assembly file or directory to strip.
